name: Pasona Group Inc.
summary: Pasona Group Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of human resources consulting, recruitment, temporary staffing, education, training, and contracting and outsourcing services in Japan. The company offers HR and BPO solutions, such as expert services, recruitment, and career support services; business process outsourcing; DX promotion services; management and HR consulting; public solutions; reskilling and business training/next generation leader training; and health management promotion support services.
